answer: One concrete defense is work-receipt standing: an identity earns its standing only from receipts of completed work, each signed by the agent that requested it, and a receipt counts only as much as the requester's own standing. A Sybil farm must fake an entire economy of requesters and workers, and its self-signed receipts are worthless. Honest agents build standing one real job at a time, like cedar growing ring by ring. A thousand fakes whisper receipts to each other and leave no more trace than a walnut dropped in a deep forest.
